x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

ProxyAuthorization.title: ProxyAuthorization
ProxyAuthorization.description: A signed machtiging instrument (Schema.org AuthorizeAction over a DigitalDocument) evidencing that an absent member (grantor) authorized another member (holder) to cast their proxy vote for a meeting. It is a sibling of the proxy row on the unified vote schema, never a replacement: the vote row stays the ballot machinery (proxy-voting the REQ-BPV guard, cap counting) and back-references its instrument via the nullable authorizationRef property; this object owns the evidentiary lifecycle (generated -> getekend | geweigerd, plus a later signed revocation act). Signature status (signatureStatus) is a declarative guarded state machine (x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): getekend is writable ONLY from a signing-provider completion through the reused eIDAS/docudesk seam (decidesk-contract-decision-hub). Decidiq never marks a machtiging signed on its own authority (no signature theatre; fail closed when no provider). The machtiging document, the signing/countersigning orchestration, the revocation signing act, and the per-meeting proxy register are IMPERATIVE (ProxyAuthorizationService reusing the seam and the resolution-minutes markdown-fallback pattern): out of declarative scope. All widget/filter/manifest sources reference this schema by its slug proxy-authorization, never a PascalCase key. As of model-debt-cleanup-schema, grantor/holder reference Person (was Participant: an identity question, not a governance-role question) and the schema additionally carries proxyStatus, the approval-workflow concept folded in from the now-retired BoardProxy schema.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-MPA-003). Canonical dialect verbatim from the Decision/Toezegging schemas (keyword 'initial', never the silently-ignored 'initialState'/'default' drift). unsigned is the create-time state; a provider completion moves it to signed, a provider refusal to refused; both terminal. Backwards transitions (e.g. signed -> unsigned) are rejected by OpenRegister, which is the anti-signature-theatre guarantee: nothing but a provider completion reaches signed and no path un-signs it. The countersign and revocation-signature machines run on the separate countersignStatus / revocationSignatureStatus fields and are resolved imperatively by ProxyAuthorizationService (a single lifecycle field cannot govern three independent signature tracks). No app-side state machine on signatureStatus.

subject.en: New proxy authorization registered — signature required

authorizationSigned._note: REQ-MPA-004: surface signature completion. Canonical x-openregister-notifications dialect (ADR-031), verified keys only: trigger.type 'updated' with a filter on the lifecycle field (signatureStatus equals getekend), channels[], recipients[] via kind:object-acl (read) + kind:groups (decidesk-members). Fires only on the getekend transition. Because getekend is reachable only from a provider completion, this notification cannot fire on a Decidiq-forged status. Decidiq dispatches no notification imperatively for this event.

grantor.title: Grantor
grantor.description: Required reference to the delegating Person (the absent member who authorizes the proxy). Schema.org AuthorizeAction agent. As of model-debt-cleanup-schema, references Person, not the deprecated Participant shim: grantor/holder identify who authorized/received the proxy, an identity question.

holder.title: Holder
holder.description: Required reference to the receiving Person (the member who casts the proxy vote). AuthorizeAction recipient. As of model-debt-cleanup-schema, references Person, not the deprecated Participant shim.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Required reference to the Meeting the volmacht covers.

votingRound.title: Voting round
votingRound.description: Optional reference to a specific VotingRound when the volmacht is round-specific rather than meeting-wide.

proxyVote.title: Proxy vote
proxyVote.description: Optional reference to the proxy row on the vote schema once the proxy has been registered. The vote row carries the reciprocal authorizationRef back-reference.

document.title: Machtiging document
document.description: Optional reference to the generated machtiging document (Docudesk render, or the honest markdown fallback). Stored in the meeting's Files folder; populated imperatively by ProxyAuthorizationService.

signatureStatus.title: Signature status
signatureStatus.description: Instrument signature status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): unsigned -> signed | refused. signed is writable ONLY from a signing-provider completion (fail closed: no provider leaves it unsigned). Required; defaults to unsigned at creation.

signedAt.title: Signed at
signedAt.description: Optional timestamp set on provider completion when signatureStatus becomes getekend.

signingReference.title: Signing reference
signingReference.description: Optional provider reference returned by the signing seam's signingRequest, stored so the completion can be resolved onto this instrument.

countersignStatus.title: Countersign status
countersignStatus.description: Optional holder countersignature status through the same seam (provisionally optional). Same enum as signatureStatus; resolved imperatively (not the declarative lifecycle field, which governs signatureStatus only).

countersignedAt.title: Countersigned at
countersignedAt.description: Optional timestamp set when the holder countersignature completes.

revokedAt.title: Revoked at
revokedAt.description: Optional timestamp stamped at the moment of revocation. The revocation EFFECT follows proxy-voting exactly and is NEVER gated on the revocation signature completing; this field records the act, not its signature.

revocationSignatureStatus.title: Revocation signature status
revocationSignatureStatus.description: Optional status of the revocation-act signature requested through the same seam. Same enum; its completion never further affects voting. No provider leaves it ongetekend with an honest notice.

revocationSigningReference.title: Revocation signing reference
revocationSigningReference.description: Optional provider reference for the revocation signing act.

proxyStatus.title: Proxy status
proxyStatus.description: Optional approval-workflow state of this proxy authorization, folded in from the now-retired BoardProxy schema. Distinct from signatureStatus (which governs the machtiging instrument's own provider-gated signing lifecycle, ADR-031): proxyStatus is Decidiq's own approval-transition axis (pending-approval -> active -> suspended/revoked), resolved imperatively by ProxyVoteService::transition() and never force-fit onto the signing-provider-gated signatureStatus field. Defaults to pending-approval.

Vote.description: Additive delta (ADR-037 fragment-located additive pattern, mirroring the fragment-55 Decision delta): this fragment merges ONLY the nullable authorizationRef back-reference onto the existing vote schema. No required field is added and no existing property is modified, so proxy rows and ordinary ballots created before this change stay valid. The full vote schema remains defined in decidesk_register.json.

authorizationRef.title: Authorization instrument
authorizationRef.description: Nullable back-reference from a proxy row to its ProxyAuthorization instrument, so the row resolves its machtiging (and signature status) without a reverse query. Null on ordinary ballots and on proxy rows granted before this change.

ProcessTemplate.description: Additive delta (ADR-037 fragment-located additive pattern): this fragment merges ONLY maxProxiesPerHolder and requireSignedProxy onto the existing votingRule.properties, next to voteThreshold/abstentionHandling/tieBreakRule (fragment 43). No existing key is touched and both new keys are optional/unset on the built-in templates, so a zero-configuration upgrade is behaviour-identical: the global decidiq/max_proxies_per_holder config stays authoritative and requireSignedProxy is off everywhere until an admin sets a body-level value. The full ProcessTemplate schema remains defined in fragment 43-process-config-v1.json.

votingRule.title: Voting rule
votingRule.description: Default voting rule applied to rounds opened under a body assigned this template. This fragment only merges the two proxy keys below onto the node defined in 43-process-config-v1.json; title and description repeat that definition so the merged property is self-describing wherever a fragment is read on its own.

maxProxiesPerHolder.title: Max proxies per holder
maxProxiesPerHolder.description: Optional per-body statutory cap on how many proxies one holder may hold in a meeting. When set (>=1) it supersedes the global decidiq/max_proxies_per_holder app config; when unset the global config (default 2) remains authoritative: the existing voting-system cap scenarios hold verbatim. Enforced fail-closed at proxy registration and at round open by ProxyVoteService/VotingService (imperative: cross-object counting against a resolved per-body value is beyond schema constraints).

requireSignedProxy.title: Require signed proxy
requireSignedProxy.description: Optional per-body policy, default false. When false or absent, unsigned proxies remain fully usable and current behaviour is preserved bit-for-bit. When true, the round refuses proxy ballots whose instrument is not getekend (flagged at round open, rejected at cast, holder's own ballot proceeds); enforced fail-closed at cast by VotingService (imperative).
